title: After the deity and its seat
odia:
ଦିଅଁଙ୍କୁ ଖାଇ, ଖଟୁଲି ଖାଇ
ଆହୁରି ପଚାରେ ପୂଜାରୀ କାହିଁ।
literal_meaning: Having devoured the deity and the little seat, still asking, “Where is the priest?”
meaning_odia: ଦିଅଁ ଓ ଖଟୁଲି ଖାଇସାରି ମଧ୍ୟ ପୂଜାରୀ କାହିଁ ବୋଲି ପଚାରିବାର ଅତିରଞ୍ଜିତ ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ବହୁତ କିଛି ନେଇସାରି ମଧ୍ୟ ଆହୁରି ଚାହିଁବାର ଅତୃପ୍ତି ଏଥିରେ ଦିଶେ। ଶେଷ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ଆଉ ଏକ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଖୋଜାଯାଉଛି; ପୂଜାରୀଙ୍କୁ ଖାଇଦେଲା ବୋଲି ଧାଡ଼ିଟି କହୁନାହିଁ।
explanation: The appetite has already passed through the deity and its little seat, yet the question seeks someone else. Our editorial reading is of acquisitiveness that does not stop after consuming what is available. The grotesque escalation gives the saying its force; it is not a report of an actual event.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone takes nearly all the shared supplies and immediately asks what else is available. A colleague recalls the saying’s appetite that still looks for another target.
cultural_context: Deity, seat and priest form a connected sequence. The first two have been consumed in the image; the last remains the object of a question, making the appetite seem unfinished. ଖଟୁଲି is a small cot or seat, read here in the deity’s setting.

witnesses.locator: Page24, seventh item beginning ଦିଅଁଙ୍କୁ ଖାଇ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact wording retained. Small seat is contextual ଖଟୁଲି rendering based on small-cot sense. Exaggerated appetite/greed explanation is editorial, not a claim about a recorded event.

odia_summary: ବହୁତ କିଛି ନେଇସାରି ମଧ୍ୟ ଆହୁରି ଚାହିଁବାର ଅତୃପ୍ତି।
english_summary: An appetite that keeps seeking more after consuming what is there.
